subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] P5 vt-crowding-abm 升 READY_FOR_SUBMISSION (4.7★ + 0 MAJOR; portfolio 第二篇)
body:
Alert level: info
Title: P5 vt-crowding-abm 升 READY_FOR_SUBMISSION (4.7★ + 0 MAJOR; portfolio 第二篇)

## 觸發條件

P5 (vt-crowding-abm) 從 review → **ready_for_submission** stage 達標 (commit 548fbd5c)。

v4 paper-review-cycle round (2026-04-28):
- **Academic**: 0 CRITICAL / 0 SEVERE / 0 MAJOR / 2 MED / 5 MINOR — **4.7★/5** (v3 4.2 → v4 4.7, +0.5★)
- **Citation**: 0 MAJOR / 0 MED / 2 MINOR
- **預測 FRL acceptance**: ~90% (post v4.1 ~92-95%)

v3 13 fixes 全 verified clean (1 SEVERE + 3 MAJOR + 7 MED + 6 MINOR 全處理或 deferred); v4.1 same-day batch 補完 sim-count unify 46,800 + AI-ack relocate + cole/baltas DOI。

reviews 歸檔 paper/vt-crowding-abm/review_history/v4/{academic,citation}_review_report.md + README.md

## 影響

直接服務 Mission 第 3 條（top-tier journal 投稿）。P5 是 9-paper portfolio **第二篇 ready_for_submission**（首篇 P6 PRG 於 2026-04-27 升 ready）。

P5 contribution claim: family-level positive-feedback crowding threshold framework；43,300 → 46,800 sims 跨 K827v3 + K1261 + K1262 + K1262b；17/17 robustness checks (12 strategy-spec + 5 microstructure)；NoiseControl falsifier 100% null；reproduce GREEN 47/47。

## 6/6 Stage Gate

| # | Criterion | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | latex >=4★ | ✅ 4.7★ |
| 2 | citation 0 MAJOR + <=3 MED | ✅ 0/0 + 2 MINOR |
| 3 | reproduce GREEN | ✅ 47/47 100% |
| 4 | compile clean | ✅ 26p, 0 errors |
| 5 | FRL >=R&R | ✅ ~90-95% |
| 6 | self-contained | ✅ |

## 建議行動

用戶決策即可：

1. **若決定投稿 FRL**: 主線程下個 slot 可 dispatch P5 cover letter + suggested reviewers prep（類比 P6 7d2149a0 pattern；ABM 領域 reviewer pool 與 GARCH 不同）。建議 reviewer 候選: Bookstaber (OFR ABM) / Cont (Imperial herd-behavior) / LeBaron (Brandeis ABM finance) / Lillo (Pisa, market microstructure ABM) / Avanidhar (Subrahmanyam UCLA crowding)。

2. **若延遲投稿**: 維持 ready stage + monthly review loop（v5 預計 2026-05-28 自動觸發）。

3. **若改投他刊**: cover letter contribution claim 可微調 reuse；reviewer pool 跨 journal 通用（ABM finance 領域偏窄，重複率高）。

無 alert action 需主線程做 — 等用戶 reply。
